## Important Rules

- **Never read source code during browser discovery.** Test as a user.
- **Keep backend-only runs short.** When the diff has no UI files, cap the browser pass at 30 seconds (Quick mode) and spend the rest of the run on the project's unit tests, which verify logic changes more precisely than the browser can.
- **Screenshot every issue.** Check the console after every interaction.
- **Never include credentials.** Use `[REDACTED]`.
